summary: 23 CPU-first media tools behind one MCP server: background removal, EXIF/GPS stripping, resize, thumbnails, GIFs, video trim. 20 of them report "network": "none" in their own response payload rather than in a README (remove_background, alone or inside batch_process, fetches its model weights once), and a test fails if any other module ever imports an HTTP client. GPU only for the optional Real-ESRGAN upscaler, no paid API. 351 tests.
